The reason why the news stepped on the pain points of pig farmers in central Pingtung is related to the changes made by the local black pig industry for epidemic prevention in recent years. Pingtung is an important black pig production area. In the past, six heaps of Hakka areas have used human surplus food to raise pigs for many years.
